scope.process: direct launched PID only; descendants are not included
scope.memory: RSS and virtual size for this process; Windows virtual size is private commit
scope.cpu: process CPU time; derived percent is process CPU divided by elapsed wall time and may exceed 100%
scope.thread_count: process thread count is opt-in; it may add platform-dependent sampling overhead
scope.io: process I/O counters where the operating system exposes them; not physical disk traffic
scope.system_memory: system-wide virtual memory and swap snapshot
scope.volumes: free and total capacity for explicitly listed paths; not free VRAM
